'''''Atriplex prostrata''''', called the '''spear-leaved orache''', '''hastate orache''', '''thin-leaf orache''', '''triangle orache''', and '''fat hen''', is a widespread species of flowering plant in the saltbush genus ''[[Atriplex]]'', native to Europe, Macaronesia, northern Africa, Ethiopia, the Middle East, western Siberia, and Central Asia, and introduced to temperate North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Japan, and Primorsky Krai in far eastern Russia.<ref>{{cite web
